title: Warm Dense Filipino Pork Lechon
description: A traditional Filipino dish featuring a whole roasted pig, served with a side of mustard and rye bread, this version is adapted to be dense and light, with a Mediterranean twist
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit
Score the pork shoulder in a crisscross pattern, cutting about 1/4 inch deep
In a small bowl, mix together the mustard, olive oil, garlic, lemon juice, salt, and black pepper
Rub the mixture all over the pork shoulder, making sure to get some into the scored lines
Place the pork shoulder in a roasting pan and put it in the oven
Roast the pork for 20 minutes per pound, or until it reaches an internal temperature of 160 degrees Fahrenheit
While the pork is cooking, slice the rye bread into 1 inch thick slices
When the pork is done, let it rest for 10 minutes before slicing it thinly
Serve the pork with the rye bread and a side of additional mustard, if desired
